intent: A two-leaf hinged latch: two flat leaves joined by a pin_hinge matched pair sharing one coaxial pivot bore, folding from flat-open to 90 degrees closed.

parts.description: Hinge leaf A (pin_hinge leaf_a member), the anchor leaf

interfaces.name: pivot_bore
interfaces.description: Coaxial bore carrying the shared 1.75 mm filament pivot pin

parts.engineering_rationale: no load-bearing features (pivot pin, not this leaf's material, carries the hinge shear)

parts.description: Hinge leaf B (pin_hinge leaf_b member), pose derived from hinge_leaf_a via the mate chain

interfaces.name: pivot_bore
interfaces.description: Coaxial bore carrying the shared 1.75 mm filament pivot pin

parts.engineering_rationale: no load-bearing features (pivot pin, not this leaf's material, carries the hinge shear)
